writers.hrc.dispatch: HRC derives identity, correlation and their copies from the session (managed step 1; hrc-native broker.rs `dispatch_environment`)
writers.hrc.preparation: HRC adds its plumbing ids to the dispatch env (managed step 3; broker.rs `preparation`)
writers.asp.lockedEnv: ASP's compile puts the key in the plan's `lockedEnv` (raspd `locked_env`, Bun `composeAgentLocalEnv`); on a managed launch HRC removes every locked key from its map (step 4), so ASP has the last word
writers.buildAgentSessionEnv: the TypeScript builder in core/config/src/runtime/agent-session-env.ts, on an unmanaged `asp agent` launch
writers.hrc-pty: the hrcpty supervisor that starts the harness, outside HRC's dispatch map
writers.login-profile: the operator's login shell profile (`$SHELL -lc`, step 5); the contract says it must not set or unset an identity variable (canonical, correlation, compat, project or handle rows); plumbing rows naming it record what the profile does today

classes.canonical identity: both writers emit them, same values for the same inputs
classes.canonical correlation: derived from the session's correlation; run id only when a run exists at spawn
classes.compat copy: a named function of a canonical key. The row says which launch path writes it today and lists its readers; this contract does not add a compat copy to a path that lacks it. A compat row is removed by a table change once its reader list is empty, never by a writer alone
classes.project discovery id: not a copy. With a project root ASP's compile writes it in `lockedEnv`: the scope's project id, or the basename of the project root when the scope has none, so it can be present when AGENT_PROJECT is absent. On a managed launch with no project root HRC writes it, equal to AGENT_PROJECT
classes.locked project root: written by ASP's compile in `lockedEnv` on both launch paths whenever there is a project root. HRC also derives it at step 1 and removes it at step 4, so HRC never has the last word on it
classes.ASP materialization: the agent's own directories and materialization pointers, written by ASP's compile in `lockedEnv` on both launch paths. Not identity; listed so that every variable a seat receives from the platform has a named writer
classes.derived handle, managed only: written by HRC only: `agent[@project[:task]][~lane]`, lane omitted when `main`. It leaves out the role, so for a role-scoped seat it is not the session's identity and does not round-trip; AGENT_SCOPE_REF is
classes.runtime plumbing: wiring written by HRC's writer, hrc-pty, the harness broker or the daemon's own inputs. The keys HRC's writer emits are tested as part of the exact map in the managed cases; the rest are listed with their writer
classes.removed: written today, read by nothing; the write is deleted
